posts.author: Hans
posts.content_md:
What does a "tanning developer" mean does this mean that the developer gives a "tan" to the emulsion or does it mean that the developer surrounds the developed crystals with a hardened gelatin structure and prevent shrinking when the crystals are washed away? (I remember reading something about that related to Pyrogallol).

If the developer hardens the gelatin around the developed crystals, would it not be benificial to dry the bleached hologram in a DCG kind of way? (Pre-swell in warm water, and then suck out the water violently with alcohol, in order to increase the density differences of the gelatin)

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: A "tanning" developer hardens the emulsion, like tanning animal skin makes it leather. Drying a hologram in graded alcohol baths is a good idea, but the benefits (a bit higher DE and a little less noise) generally do not outweigh the hassle of doing the procedure in a home studio.
